name: Astartes Forge A4 Chapter Frame Golden Standard

rules: Artwork must reach all four A4 edges.
The visible outer boundary is straight and page-aligned on all four sides.
No transparent bites, gaps or cut-outs may connect to a page edge.
No ears, wings, horns, weapons or other ornaments may protrude beyond or appear clipped by the A4 canvas.
There is one clear, uninterrupted title field; it may not be split into left/right panels.
The central emblem belongs above the title field and may intrude no more than about 5 px into the usable title-text field.
The title field must remain visually quiet enough for long unit names and points text.
The frame supplies a titleSurface swatch so the renderer can choose readable title text automatically.
Each Chapter keeps its own natural inner ornament contour; never copy another Chapter's alpha mask onto it.
The central transparent opening must be one dominant connected region.
Do not punch secondary transparent holes into side rails or the footer to make panels fit.
Bottom ornamentation must remain non-critical because live panels may overlap it on dense sheets.
Side ornamentation may extend inward and may be covered by live panels; it may not extend outward beyond the page.

artDirectionRules: Chapter identity changes materials, heraldry and ornament, not the physical page geometry.
The lower border should be less information-dense than the upper/side decoration so panel overlap is visually forgiving.
Generate or compose at the final A4 portrait aspect ratio; do not repair a bad frame later by destructive crop or foreign alpha masks.
promotionGate: Frame asset exists and is 2480x3508 RGBA.
validate-frames.py passes all automated geometry/alpha/title checks.
Golden-reference hashes remain unchanged unless this standard is intentionally versioned.
Manual review confirms no clipped outer ornament and the title plaque is a single usable field.
Only after these checks may chapter-visual-registry.js set frameReady=true.
